Subject: Request: temporary reserve bridge & GPU fallback for NovusAI POC

Team — forwarding NovusAI's ask and my recommended guardrails. Summary: Novus wants to start a 30-day POC next week and needs a short-term reserved slab of H200-class capacity with an automated fallback to H100 for burst traffic. They also asked for a modest overage discount while procurement completes a PO. Details: 1) Reserve: 8 H200 slices (reserved) for 30 days starting 2027-05-20; 2) Burst behavior: allow up to 120 vCPU-equivalent hours/day on H100 fallback when H200 pool is saturated; 3) Overage pricing: customer requested 30% off standard overage for the trial period; 4) Reservation hold: they need us to hold the reservation while their legal signs the SOW (target PO by 2027-06-03). Attached: Novus_SOW_v1.pdf and a short usage forecast.

Why this is urgent: the POC kickoff is timed to a partner demo the week of 5/24 and Novus will walk if we can't guarantee predictable capacity for the demo. Risks: granting a large H200 temporary hold could squeeze other Dedicated customers in the us-west pool.

My asks: - Lauren / Deal Desk: can you propose an approvable one-off term (pricing & guardrails) we can offer as an exec-approved exception? - Marissa: can you sign off on a temporary reserve + capped burst arrangement if Deal Desk outlines the limits?

Note to execs: I recommend approving a limited bridge: reserve + conditional fallback to H100 for bursts with a capped daily burst hours and a capped blended overage rate (e.g., reserve rate + 15% on H100 bursts) — less than Novus asked but protects capacity. If approved, I'll confirm with Novus and require PO submission or prepayment to hold beyond 30 days.

Thanks,
